roads.name: Scenic Loop Drive
words: Properly twisty: 68 curves in 12.9 miles, about 5 a mile.
About 1.4 miles in the middle are tamer.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 1,956 to 2,517 ft, with 2,295 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 25 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.15 g.
